description.value: The Grand Park Hotel & Suites is a mid-scale hotel on the Granville entertainment strip in downtown Vancouver, within walking distance of False Creek, Yaletown, English Bay, and Stanley Park. Room types range from standard queens to full-kitchen suites and a penthouse, and a top-floor rooftop lounge with communal kitchen and mountain views sets it apart from typical urban hotels. An on-site White Spot restaurant, 24-hour fitness centre with sauna, and secured underground parkade make it a practical urban base for touring cyclists arriving in the city.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 58m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and fully corroborates OSM contact details. The site confirms laundry machines for guest use, free Wi-Fi in all rooms, and an onsite White Spot restaurant. The amenities page references a secured underground parkade for cars and notes that 'bicycles and e-bikes rule the streets,' but this is atmospheric rather than a bike storage offer — no dedicated bike storage arrangement is described anywhere on the site, so both required criteria remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, operating property well-positioned for urban touring cyclists, but neither required WWC criterion can be confirmed from the website — bike storage is never mentioned explicitly. Direct outreach to confirm whether cyclists can store bikes in the underground parkade or a designated area would likely resolve this.
